theorem explicit_formula_gen {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {K c : ℝ} (hφ : GoodSmoothing φ K c) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k : ℕ, T k ∈ Icc ((k : ℝ) + 1) ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => ∑ u ∈ zerosRect χ (T k), (multRect χ (T k) u : ℂ) * (mellin φ u * (x : ℂ) ^ u))
        atTop (𝓝 (-SsumG χ φ x - (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
          ∫ y : ℝ, hIntG χ φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I))) :=

note: `Explicit.explicit_formula_gen` states the shift as a limit over good heights T_k (`Explicit.good_height`), proven from the rectangle identity `Explicit.rect_identity`, with horizontal sides tending to 0 and left line at ℜs = −1/2. It has no separate residue term R, and `Explicit.explicit_formulaD` gives the same identity for any LDatum.
